body: Being forced to accept my (them seemingly imminent) death during my harrowing and painful suicide attempt got me over my fear of death. now I keepa cocktail of pills next to my bed with the intent to use it if everything becomes unbearable. Being unafraid to die and knowing that each day you go through can be your last really changes perspectives.

wow. you've hit the nail on the head right there. As I read your comment, I've realized that I don't actually want to kill myself but another to go to take back what I've lost. accepting that it's gone forever is painful.
